Safety & Security Ecosystem

Technology that’s exponentially more powerful, together.

Explore ecosystem
Critical communications
We make devices and networks that perform exceptionally in the harshest conditions, so you can stay connected and communicate clearly.
Command center
We unify voice, video and data feeds into the command center, providing perspective to help make decisions with focus, accuracy and speed.
Video security
We design video security systems powered by responsibly-built AI analytics, so you can understand risks and act with certainty.
Managed & support services
We provide managed and support services for keeping your technology secure and up-to-date, so you can be confident in performance.
Safety & Security Ecosystem

We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. See what safer can do.

Motorola Solutions is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, United States. With a rich history of innovation since 1928, our mission is to advance safety and security globally through an ecosystem of technologies that helps protect people, property and places.

Understanding what matters to you

From our flexible work model to our emphasis on giving back, we empower each and every Motorolan to be their most authentic self - and do
their best work.

Take time for yourself and your family

  • Flexible work models
  • Paid time off
  • Paid parental and family leave

Prioritize your health and wellness

  • Health care benefits
  • Global wellness resources
  • Employee assistance programs

Expand your opportunities and potential

  • Rotation programs
  • Mentor relationships
  • Learning and development opportunities

Enjoy rewards for excellent performance

  • Retirement benefits
  • Employee bonuses
  • Stock grants & employee stock purchase plan

Our values drive everything we do

More than just words, they are the traits that define us, and they represent the fundamental beliefs that we share as Motorolans.

  • Inclusive

    We foster a people-first culture that empowers our customers, communities and each other to thrive.

  • Driven

    We keep it simple by focusing on what matters most so we can seize opportunities with speed and confidence.

  • Innovative

    We constantly create ingenious solutions to the real challenges of today, tomorrow and beyond.

  • Accountable

    We stand behind the work we do, the contributions we make and the high business standards we maintain.

  • Passionate

    We meet challenges with energy and determination, always pursuing ever-higher standards.

  • Partners

    We work with our customers to address obstacles before they become challenges.

Our differences make us stronger

Inclusion is a mindset that influences our strategy and puts people first.

The start of an exceptional career begins here

The start of an exceptional career begins here

At Motorola Solutions, we believe the next big idea can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time. Our student programs and internships across the world are designed with you in mind. You’ll work on real projects with real-world impacts, because the work you do here matters.

Explore programs

Eligibility: 

  • Must be a full-time student enrolled in a post secondary degree program

  • Must be returning to university in the fall following summer internship

Benefits: 

  • Paid internship

  • Paid holidays

Timeline: Applications are typically open between September and March, with the internship program beginning in May.
